about: D-42 SECTION_DRIFT (test_composer.py): catalog sections vs document builder doc types (assets/doc_theme.json) and Confluence page types (pagelib.py PAGE_TYPES, OPTIONAL_SECTIONS). A null target is skipped only when its note is present.

sop.reason: one SOP structure in all three: catalog sop, document sop, page sop

release-notes.doc_note: release notes are a reference sheet (layout sheet): sheets accept any doc_type id and have no required section list in the document builder
release-notes.reason: the page type is the long-lived copy; the PDF is a sheet

user-guide.page_note: user guides publish with doc_to_page.py from the same doc.json (page_type general, PAGE_TEXTBOOK_PARITY), so page sections match the document by construction; page type guide is the native Confluence guide, a different format
user-guide.reason: the catalog user guide is the document builder user-guide type

how-to.catalog_note: no catalog format by design: how-to page requests go to confluence-page-builder, whose how-to page type is the single source

empty_anatomy: an empty catalog anatomy means the plan takes the document builder type's required sections, so it matches the document by construction

equivalences.reason: satisfied by the document builder's automatic revisions appendix when the mapped doc type has revisions: true
